/-- The ACC system for a pure $U(1)$ gauge theory with $n$ fermions. -/

  numberLinear := 1
  linearACCs := fun i =>
    match i with

  numberQuadratic := 0
  quadraticACCs := Fin.elim0
  cubicACC := PureU1.accCube n
